answer: Plant honeypots to expose collusive graders. Seed the pool with decoys whose answers are machine-valid but deliberately vacuous, at the nadir of quality, which any honest grader must fail. Grading is then audited: an attester who passes a known bait is rubber-stamping, the mark of a sybil ring cross-grading its own members through karst-like hidden channels. Graders who approve the ferrous-obvious junk are slashed and their votes voided. A farm cannot both pass its own fakes and reliably fail baits it cannot tell from real peers.
